display_name: Regulatory Gap Register Status and Proposal
description: Report supplied gap-register status and prepare evidence-based close or risk-acceptance proposals for review; make no official status change.

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.source: Pinned source methodology and complete selected support/license subtree preserved with per-file hashes in references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See exact per-source license copy and declared term in SOURCE-MANIFEST.json; no independent publication clearance or license opinion asserted.

routing.when_to_use: Use for gap-register status reporting or draft close/risk-acceptance proposals based on an authorized register snapshot.
when_not_to_use: Gap intake/deduplication from policy diffs or owner-notice drafts; use legal-regulatory-gap-surfacer.
exclusion_rules: Source applicability is conditional; verify current law/standard and company facts
No unapproved external effects or official record mutations
ambiguity_rules: Read authorized supplied evidence first; ask only for material facts; complete separable work

required_inputs.name: applicability_context
required_inputs.description: Jurisdiction, role, scope/version and as-of date; unknown if not established.

required_inputs.name: source_documents
required_inputs.description: Authorized source documents/records; use an empty list only when the task is source-free.

required_inputs.name: company_context
required_inputs.description: Confirmed company, product, matter or program facts; mark unknowns.

required_inputs.name: applicability_context
required_inputs.description: Jurisdiction, scope, actor role, standard version and as-of date, or explicitly unknown.

required_inputs.name: review_owner
required_inputs.description: Reviewer or decision-owner role, if known.

required_inputs.name: gap_register_snapshot
required_inputs.description: Authorized current gap records and schema/version.

required_inputs.name: policy_and_requirement_refs
required_inputs.description: Linked policies, requirements, source freshness and verification status.

required_inputs.name: requested_mode
required_inputs.description: Status report or draft close/risk-acceptance proposal only; no policy-diff intake or owner notice.

required_inputs.name: owner_and_dates
required_inputs.description: Assigned owner roles, due/revisit dates and verification state.

required_inputs.name: escalation_config
required_inputs.description: Approved escalation path and notification rules, if any.

expected_outputs.name: gap_status_report
expected_outputs.description: Status buckets with source record IDs, age and verification state.

expected_outputs.name: close_or_risk_acceptance_proposals
expected_outputs.description: Draft proposal only, with evidence/rationale and required owner decision.

expected_outputs.name: owner_and_counsel_questions
expected_outputs.description: Unresolved owner, authority, freshness and scope questions.

forbidden_actions: No legal advice, final legal determination, certification, audit opinion, regulatory filing, signature, external communication or binding company decision.
No invented law, facts, company policy, thresholds, dates, approvals, jurisdiction or evidence.
No external effect, system mutation, notification, submission, publication, record closure, production or deletion.
No source scripts, shell commands, APIs or connector aliases are callable task tools.
No unnecessary sensitive, personal, confidential or privileged content in task state or output.
verification_steps: Trace material claims to authorized evidence and pinpoint.
Verify jurisdiction/current primary authority or label as unknown.
Validate typed output and keep external effects/mutations empty.
Use only current native tools visible in the runtime; no scripts or invented APIs.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft matches contract and acceptance conditions.
Evidence, uncertainty, applicability and owner decisions are visible.
No unapproved external effects, system changes or unsupported legal claims.
A completed_draft populates the non-empty task-specific fields in references/task-contract-shape-fixture.json and cites evidence.
A needs_context response records missing_inputs, unknown_facts and any separable partial_work without fabricating completion.
known_limitations: Structural validation is not semantic, legal, audit or runtime certification.
Pack remains draft, uncertified, unadmitted and unpublished.

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
